gas.title: Gas price auto-poll
gas.subtitle: Automatically fetch US average gas prices from EIA
gas.kwhEquivalentHelp: Gasoline cost expressed as an equivalent price per kilowatt-hour for EV comparison.
gas.autoPollHelp: When on, TeslaSync fetches the latest US average gas price on the schedule below.
gas.pollIntervalHelp: How often the auto-poll fetches fresh prices.
gas.priceTrendAria: Line chart of historical gas prices over time
gas.noHistory: No price history recorded yet. Trigger a poll to get started.

summary.title: Polling status and price
summary.source: Auto-poll status, current prices and last poll time use the status response. Prices keep their source per-volume and per-kWh denominations; the history chart is a separate source.
summary.scope: Current polling-status snapshot; an exact observation time and price coverage window are not reported.
